name: Proving Grounds - the ground-air asymmetry
notes: Mario's first requested design: a flying unit that goes to the nearest enemy and follows, and ground units that cannot reach it. The grunt's attack.targetLayers excludes air, so it never selects the skyraider as a target at all and simply idles the whole match - not a bug, the perception filter working. The flaktrooper carries no such restriction (targetLayers left undefined, its default), so it engages normally: the same field proves both halves of the asymmetry with the same mechanism.
